'''Snowy Dawn''' is a [[wolf]] known to [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Activities==
Snowy Dawn is an irascible [[wolf]] who once killed a leopard by himself. Injuries from the fight sometimes keeps him from sleeping very long at a stretch. His pack hunts near [[Malden]], [[Altara]]. His pack aids Perrin during [[Faile Bashere|Faile's]] rescue from the [[Shaido War]].{{ref/book|11|26}}
